deliverable.renderer: Vanilla Canvas 2D — custom 3D projection (perspective + orthographic) with a depth-sorted painter's-algorithm primitive engine and flat directional shading. No WebGL, no libraries.

requirements.spec: 忽略其他文件，只进行单 html 文件输出
requirements.evidence: One self-contained answer.html (HTML+CSS+JS inline). No external requests; opens directly via file:// offline.

requirements.spec: 使用刚性线、可形变线与节点作为模拟基础
requirements.evidence: Model is explicitly a node/link constraint system: RIGID links = upper & lower A-arms (const-length), knuckle (UBJ-LBJ), tie-rod, spindle; DEFORMABLE link = coilover spring/damper (variable length); NODEs = 11 joints (chassis pivots, ball joints, tie-rod ends, hub, spring seats). Color-coded, with a topology panel (07) enumerating nodes/links and a legend.

requirements.spec: 生成一个双叉臂悬挂显示页面
requirements.evidence: Full front-left double-wishbone corner: upper/lower triangular control arms, upright knuckle, spindle/hub, wheel & tire, coilover, tie-rod + steering rack, chassis reference frame.

Travel slider (-80..+85 mm) plus animated bounce with 3 waveforms (Sine / Bump decaying-oscillation / Square), adjustable rate (0.15-2.5 Hz) and amplitude (10-82 mm). Whole linkage articulates in real time.

requirements.spec: 前轮转向拉杆联动车轮
requirements.evidence: Steering-rack input displaces the rack node; the fixed-length tie-rod rotates the knuckle about the live kingpin axis, turning the wheel. Solved forward (rack -> wheel angle) with an analytic inverse; auto steering-sweep animation. Road-wheel angle, toe and bump-steer reported live.

Motion-path traces of UBJ, LBJ, wheel centre and kingpin-at-ground over full travel, plus a kingpin-axis sweep fan. Rendered in 3D and in the Front/Top orthographic analysis views; annotated with the front-view instant centre (IC).

requirements.spec: 尽可能演示出真实结构
requirements.evidence: True 3D spatial geometry with realistic hard points: kingpin inclination (SAI ~6.5 deg), caster (~4.3 deg), static camber -1 deg, negative camber gain in compression, scrub-radius change, bump-steer, spring motion ratio. Kinematics solved from actual rigid-link constraints (not scripted animation).

requirements.spec: 工业软件风格，准确、专业
requirements.evidence: CAD-style dark UI: numbered panels, monospace technical readouts, orthographic viewport tabs (3D / Front-YZ / Top-XY / Isometric), axis triad, 100 mm scale bar, live kinematic curves, telemetry grid, status bar. Sharp 1 px borders throughout.

requirements.spec: 不要 emoji、圆边、阴影等非必要元素
requirements.evidence: Zero emoji (only technical arrow glyphs, 3 of which are inside code comments). border-radius:0 everywhere (explicitly set). No box-shadow / text-shadow / drop-shadow / filter. Only subtle flat CAD panel/viewport gradients.

kinematics_model.coordinate_frame: X = forward, Y = lateral (outboard +), Z = up; units mm
kinematics_model.suspension_solve: Lower A-arm rotates about its chassis axis (parameter phi). Upper ball joint = intersection of the upper A-arm locus circle with a sphere of fixed knuckle length centred on the lower ball joint (sphere-circle intersection, continuity-tracked branch).
kinematics_model.steering_solve: Knuckle rotates about the live kingpin axis (UBJ->LBJ). Tie-rod outer node constrained to fixed length from the rack node -> 1D bracketed root find for steer angle; closed-form inverse (rack <-> angle) also implemented and cross-validated.
kinematics_model.camber_vs_travel: +3.3 deg @ -87 mm droop  ->  -1.0 deg @ 0  ->  -6.6 deg @ +87 mm compression (correct negative camber gain)
kinematics_model.steer_range: road-wheel angle +/-35 deg corresponds to rack travel [-62, +55] mm

features: 4 projection modes: 3D perspective (orbit/zoom/pan), Front ortho YZ, Top ortho XY, Isometric
Two always-on synced sub-viewports (Front + Top) alongside the main viewport
12 layer toggles: control arms, knuckle, tie-rod/rack, coilover, wheel/tire, nodes, kingpin axis, path traces, chassis ref, ground grid, annotations, dimensions
Live telemetry: camber, toe/steer, kingpin inclination, caster, scrub radius, wheel-centre track delta, coilover length, state, ride delta-Z, rack
3 kinematic curves vs travel (camber, toe/bump-steer, kingpin inclination) with live cursors and auto-ranging
Dimensions overlay (camber angle, ride height, scrub radius) via the Dimensions layer
Bounce animation (3 waveforms) + steering sweep animation
Model topology panel enumerating nodes (N1-N11), rigid links and the deformable link
Keyboard shortcuts: Space (bounce), S (steer sweep), C (centre), R (reset camera), 1-4 (views)
Mouse/touch camera: drag orbit, wheel/pinch zoom, shift-drag pan
FPS counter, bilingual EN/中文 technical labels
